$comment: MQTT binding for the M1a slice. Source: docs/bindings/MQTT.md sections 1-4.

will.$comment: MQTT.md section 4.4: retained UNAVAILABLE on {appliance}/state on link loss.

reconnect.$comment: Owner ruling: after a link loss a connection retries connect() first after initial_ms, then each wait is multiplied by factor up to max_ms, until connected; success resets it. Each connection's waits are lengthened by a deterministic skew of 0..skew_permille per mille, derived from its client id (FNV-1a 32-bit hash mod (skew_permille + 1)), so connections that lost the broker together do not retry together. With these values retries settle at once every 16..20 s.

MAST.$comment: MQTT.md sections 2-3: /cmd <INDICATION> [LIT|(LIT)] | LIT | (LIT); /state <INDICATION> | <INDICATION> (LIT). Indication words are the SignalIndication names.

LEVER.$comment: MQTT.md sections 2-3: /state SW1 (SW2) ... SW<N>; /cmd LAMP1 (LAMP2) ... LAMP<M>; all-or-nothing.

BUTTON.$comment: MQTT.md section 3: a press is BTN<k>, a release (BTN<k>). The noun is the prefix; the channel and the parentheses are the codec's.
